title: Canonical completed compactification refinement comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring with adic datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For a separated finite-type morphism $f:X\to Y$, let $c_0$ refine two compactifications $c_1,c_2$ by arrows $u_1,u_2$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Use the completed support functors $F_c$ [def-sf-completed-compact-support-calculus-data]. For a finite tuple generating the adic ideal and a derived-complete object $K$ with compatible finite etale origins [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map; def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], define $I_{c_1,c_2}=C_{u_1}C_{u_2}^{-1}:F_{c_1}K\simeq F_{c_2}K$, where $C_u:F_{\mathrm{target}(u)}K\to F_{\mathrm{source}(u)}K$ is the specified completed proper/open refinement map. These are the published cbcRefinementMap and cbcCompactificationComparison; no independence theorem is asserted.

lean.statement:
def cbcCompactificationComparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    {c₀ c₁ c₂ : Compactification f} (u₁ : c₀.Refinement c₁) (u₂ : c₀.Refinement c₂)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal)
    (K : (cbcCompleteProperty d X r a ha).FullSubcategory)
    (origins : PbcHasCompatibleEtaleOrigins X d K.obj) :
    (cbcSupport d c₁).obj K.obj ≅ (cbcSupport d c₂).obj K.obj
